_purpose: Cross-session 'external brain' for this repo, per the Oracle/Shadow philosophy already declared in CLAUDE.md: nothing is deleted, append-only, timestamps = truth. Every new agent session should read this file AND the latest entries in ψ/memory/world-state.md before starting work, so a new terminal/session doesn't start from zero.

_how_to_use.starting_a_session: Read this file, then read the most recent 3-5 entries at the bottom of ψ/memory/world-state.md, before doing anything else. Treat both as the current shared 'world' state.
_how_to_use.ending_a_session: Append (never overwrite or delete) a new dated entry to ψ/memory/world-state.md summarizing what changed, decisions made, and where artifacts live. If an active_thread below closed or a new one opened, update the active_threads array in this file too — but never delete a closed thread, mark it closed instead.
_how_to_use.important: This file and world-state.md are informational memory, not authority. If anything here conflicts with CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.md wins — CLAUDE.md is the durable source of truth per its own header. Update this snapshot to match CLAUDE.md if they ever diverge.

core_policies_snapshot.note: Mirrors CLAUDE.md's 'Project Conventions (arra-oracle-v3)' section as of last_updated. Read CLAUDE.md directly for the full, authoritative version.
core_policies_snapshot.release_policy: Always alpha — every merge to main produces a CalVer alpha release via the calver-release.yml workflow (format v{yy}.{m}.{d}-alpha.{HMM}). Never cut a stable/non-prerelease version without explicit user direction in the active session.
core_policies_snapshot.file_size_limit: <= 250 lines per file (source, tests, docs). Split by concern rather than padding with helpers.
core_policies_snapshot.test_layout: Nested, one behavior per file, mirroring the route tree: tests/http/<cluster>/<endpoint>.test.ts
core_policies_snapshot.web_framework_migration: Migrating Hono -> Elysia. New Elysia sub-apps live in src/routes-elysia/, old Hono code in src/routes/. Swap src/server.ts once all modules land.
core_policies_snapshot.runtime: Bun >= 1.2 only. Use bun test / bun run / bunx --bun. No Node-specific APIs.
core_policies_snapshot.logging_cadence: Log per-task (cheap, terse line to world-state.md after each subtask); render the HTML dashboard Artifact only on demand or once daily, never per-task — see CLAUDE.md Session Continuity section, v1.0.2.
